features.title: Return flow: settle deposit, record late/damage fees, dress moves to cleaning then available
features.evidence: 2026-07-30: the status machine + settlement. BE: RentalEntity.markPickedUp (booked→out, else 409) and markReturned (booked|out→returned — a booked rental may be returned directly when staff skipped the pickup tap; returned/cancelled→409), POST /rentals/:id/pickup + POST /rentals/:id/return (rental:pickup + rental:return policies, any staff). Return body {lateFee?, damageFee?, depositRefund?, note?} (ints ≥0) → payment rows via PaymentRecorderPort/Adapter writing the payments-owned TABLE directly (payments context is schema-only; same boundary trick as DressLookupAdapter; one transaction per settlement; zero/omitted amounts NOT recorded; the note rides on every row). Ordering trade-off documented: status flips before payments land — a recorder failure leaves a returned rental with hand-re-enterable fees, never fees on an unreturned rental. 'Cleaning then available' is DERIVED: items keep blocking through the cleaning buffer after return (no dress-status writes). today-board grew an OVERDUE list (booked|out with inclusive end < date) so late returns stay visible — the late-fee path has a surface. BE gates: build/lint/arch(156 modules, 0 violations)/test(52, +8: pickup 3, return 4, overdue projection 1). Contract regenerated (usePickupRentalHttpControllerPickup, useReturnRentalHttpControllerSettle, ReturnRentalRequestDto, TodayBoardResponseDto.overdue). FE: board is now actionable — dueOut cards get 'Đã giao váy' (pickup mutation), dueBack + overdue cards get 'Nhận về & tất toán' opening ReturnRentalDialog (RHF+zod vi-first keys, amount-string fields, blank = omitted; 409 → 'đã xử lý' toast; success invalidates every dated board query via the parameterless key); third Quá hạn section. FE gates: check/lint/test(39, +4)/build; arch 11/11 after commit. Runtime vs fresh compose DB: smoke.sh now 43 checks — pickup 200 then re-pickup 409; dueOut empties after pickup; due-back shows status out; 08-04 overdue=1:out; return with {lateFee:200000, damageFee:0, depositRefund:2800000, note} 200 then re-return 409; board empties after return; negative fee 400; unknown rental 404/404. psql proof: payments has EXACTLY late_fee 200000 + deposit_refund 2800000 (damageFee 0 skipped), note 'Trễ 1 ngày' on both, rental status=returned. Proxy proof :5173→:3000: pickup 200, return 200, board reflects it. Deferred: cancel-rental use case (enum + blocking=false semantics exist, no policy/command yet); early-return does NOT shrink blocked_period (re-bookable days stay blocked through the original buffer); no payments read/list endpoint (rows verified via psql).

features.title: Today screen: dresses due out and due back today — the screen staff open every morning
features.evidence: 2026-07-30: BE read slice GET /rentals/today-board?date=YYYY-MM-DD (date optional, default server-today; @ApiTags rentals, auth-only read). due OUT = booked rentals with lower(period)=date; due BACK = booked/out rentals with upper(period)-1=date (inclusive last day) — 'returned'/'cancelled' excluded, forward-compatible with the return flow. SQL computes both membership flags over rentals ⋈ rental_items (ranges SELECTed ::text per convention); today-board.projection groups item rows per rental, dresses sorted by code; a single-day rental appears on BOTH lists. Dress code/name via DressLookupPort (DressSnapshot extended with code+name — no catalog imports). Request DTO: @Matches date shape + @IsISO8601 strict, so 2026-02-30 is a 400, not a 500 from the ::date cast. BE gates: build/lint/arch(145 modules, 0 violations)/test(44, +3 projection specs). Contract regenerated (useGetTodayBoardHttpControllerGetSuspense, TodayBoardResponseDto/RentalDto/DressDto). features.title: Payments read slice: the money movements of a rental (deposit refund, late/damage fees) — first read surface for the payments context
features.evidence: 2026-07-30: FIRST CODE in the payments context (schema existed since bootstrap) — modules/payments with GET /rentals/:rentalId/payments (@ApiTags payments nested under the rental path, the same cross-context URL trick as rentals' reads under /dresses; auth-only read). Write side deliberately stays in rentals' return flow (PaymentRecorderAdapter) until payments grows its own use cases. BE gates: build/lint/arch(175 modules, 0 violations)/test(60, +2). Proxy proof :5173→:3000: payments = 2:deposit_refund. Deferred: deposit COLLECTION is still never recorded at create (list shows settlement rows only); payments button only on returned rows; formatVnd in vitest reads the app i18n instance so amount assertions accept both vi/en grouping.

features.title: Playwright e2e over the compose stack (deferred since fe-bootstrap): sign-in, create rental, today-board pickup/return happy path
features.evidence: 2026-07-30: @playwright/test in apps/fe (e2e/ dir, playwright.config.ts with locale vi-VN pinned — headless chromium defaults to en and the i18n detector follows navigator.language; chromium via pnpm --filter fe exec playwright install chromium). ONE serial happy-path spec (each step depends on the previous state): sign in owner → create dress (unique E2E-<run> code) → book it for TODAY single-day → morning board: customer on BOTH lists → pickup ('Đã giao váy', count 2→1, badge Đang thuê) → return dialog (refund 3,000,000 + note) → board empties → /rentals row shows Đã trả → payments dialog lists Hoàn cọc + the note. Runs against the REAL stack (fresh compose DB + BE dist + Vite :5173), green in ~5s: '1 passed'. THE E2E CAUGHT TWO REAL STALE-CACHE BUGS (staleTime 60s): (1) post-create navigation showed a /rentals list WITHOUT the new rental — new-rental onSuccess now invalidates list+board; (2) after pickup/return on the board, /rentals kept the old status — both mutations now invalidate the list too (parameterless keys prefix every filtered/dated query). Also: vitest include narrowed to src/** so it stops swallowing e2e/*.spec.ts; e2e/ + playwright.config.ts added to tsconfig include (tsc guards the spec); test-results/ + playwright-report/ gitignored. Root gates + init.sh still EXCLUDE e2e (needs browsers + running stack — AGENTS.md deviation 5 updated with the run recipe). Wait-for-settle guard on the first form fill (a fill during the lazy-route swap lands on a replaced input). FE gates: check/lint/test(48)/build green; BE untouched (60). Deferred: e2e not wired into CI; single chromium project (no firefox/webkit); no e2e for cancel/CSV-import flows.
